description: Manage cookie consent and compliance without leaving ChatGPT. Privacy laws like GDPR and CCPA require websites to get visitor consent before using cookies. CookieYes is the consent management platform (CMP) that handles this for 1.5M+ websites. This connector puts it inside your chat. Check whether your cookie banner is live. Run a cookie scan to find every cookie and tracker on your site. Review your GDPR and CCPA compliance settings. Update your cookie banner in seconds. Typical requests: "Audit my site for GDPR compliance", "Is my cookie banner active?", "Run a cookie scan and show me what you find", "Check my CCPA opt-out setup". CookieYes supports GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, and Google Consent Mode v2. That means opt-in cookie consent for European laws, and opt-out with "Do Not Sell or Share" for US ones. Built for privacy and legal teams confirming compliance, marketers checking client sites, and developers managing cookie banners. The connector covers consent management, cookie scans, and compliance checks in plain conversation.
